note: steaming geothermal water against a muted mineral shore under overcast light
why: replaces a close-up of a sauna stove; actual water, no tourists, no turquoise

note: Overhead drone view of a white motor yacht under way, its wake cutting across near-black open water
why: Almost monochrome ink-and-white, deep negative space in the water, a single hard-edged subject, no sky and no horizon to go blue

note: A long timber table laid with glassware and linen in a dim room, lit only by two tapers and a wall sconce against a deep slate-green wall
why: Deep shadow with small warm pools of candlelight, no people and no plated food, restrained palette of timber, black bentwood and dark green

note: Black-and-white view along a classical stone colonnade, low raking sun striping the travertine columns and casting long shadows across the cobbles
why: Pure tonal photograph with true blacks between the columns, ancient stone in low raking light, calm rhythmic composition and no people
